Name: 3F Military Security Area
Desc: The drone operations room in the Military Security Area is located beside the main logistics lines, making it easy to transfer and recover supplies.

Name: 2F Military Security Area
Desc: Past the security corridor lies the main administrative, training, and maintenance area of the Military Security Area, complete with standard meeting rooms and weapons maintenance facilities.

Name: Olympia Art Gallery
Desc: Operated by the WGAA, this public-facing art gallery is one of Babylonia's landmarks, combining public education, exhibitions, and collection research.

Name: Babylonia Universal Cinema
Desc: Located in the heart of the commercial district, this venue combines a cinema with a media archive, and regularly hosts themed film festivals, pop-up events, and art exhibitions.

Name: Dreamglow Gardens
Desc: An open greenhouse oasis in the commercial district, offering visitors a place to rest while learning about plant cultivation.

Name: Knowledge Promenade
Desc: A public outdoor space connecting the Olympia Art Gallery and Babylonia Universal Cinema, renovated by the WGAA at the government's request and filled with artistic flair.

Name: Cross-District Juncture
Desc: A cross-district checkpoint located near the Babylonia Universal Gallery. From here, you can go to Commercial District A.

Name: Transitional Ramp Elevator
Desc: A passage linking the Military Security Area to the Commercial District. From here, you can access the Knowledge Promenade.

Name: Transitional Ramp Elevator
Desc: A passage linking the Commercial District to the Military Security Area. From here, you can access the first floor of the Military Security Area.
